milestones.label: Graduate admission portal opens for Fall 2027 (PhD programmes)
milestones.source_text: MBZUAI's PhD programme page lists this opening date (official; read through a search excerpt because the site blocked direct fetching). Some MSc pages give 7 September 2026, and Computational Biology and Applied AI open later.

milestones.label: Application deadline for Fall 2027 graduate admission
milestones.source_text: MBZUAI's graduate pages (official; read through search excerpts) give this closing date for most programmes. Computational Biology closes 22 January 2027 and the Master in Applied AI closes 28 February 2027.

milestones.label: Admission decisions sent (Fall 2027)
milestones.source_text: MBZUAI's PhD page (official; search excerpt) says decisions go out no later than this date. A second source, a scholarship news site, reports the same date.

milestones.label: Deadline to respond to an offer (Fall 2027)
milestones.source_text: MBZUAI's graduate pages (official; search excerpt) list this as the offer response date for most programmes.
